segments.normalizedSource: ```swift extension CLKComplicationServer { // Safely access the server's active complications. @MainActor func getActiveComplications() async -> [CLKComplication] { return await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in // First, set up the notification. let center = NotificationCenter.default let mainQueue = OperationQueue.main var token: NSObjectProtocol? token = center.addObserver(forName: .CLKComplicationServerActiveComplicationsDidChange, object: nil, queue: mainQueue) { _ in center.removeObserver(token!) continuation.resume(returning: self.activeComplications!) } // Then check to see if we have a valid active complications array. if activeComplications != nil { center.removeObserver(token!) continuation.resume(returning: self.activeComplications!) } } } } ```
